bestBets.overview: Conveniently CRUSADING NIGHT and THE REGENT  jumped out together at Werribee July 17. Having his fourth jump out for the preparation, THE REGENT had the honours over CRUSADING KNIGHT (his 2nd jump out). I doubt there's much between them. ACTIVATING has shown plenty but wondered if he preferred better ground. LA REINA VEGA  was a short priced fav on debut at Seymour. That was testing ground and she ran well being just no match for a more experienced rival. LADY PUISSANCE has the advantage of two starts under her belt this time around. 1425m was always going to suit her 2nd up and she was good. She might have SOULSEASE RIVER's measure. MS PORT MELBOURNE will win races but was keen to see her on dryish ground.

raceTips.comment: La Reina Vega has the race experience and displayed enough on debut to prove to be the one to beat. The Regent impressed in a jumpout alongside Crusading Knight and Don'tdoubtagoose who each showed something as well, with that trio making their debut. Activating has also worked well.

raceTips.comment: In'kantosstar was unlucky on debut and should have won, that raced rated well enough to win here. His run here prior would  give him a hope.  TEMPERED EDGE's 2nd here 1st up was no fluke given the way he had jumped out prior. BELLABAMA is very fit and racing well on wet tracks this prep. Her turn is very close. There's plenty of subsequent winning form around ROCK CATCHER's NZ runs. Very wary of her with D Lane taking the mount. SHEISTHEBOSS has jumped out well for her return. She showed some promise in her first campaign.

raceTips.comment: Tempered Edge showed good improvement at this course first up and can run well. Bellabama has placed her last three starts and has proven very consistent. bestBets.overview: It's not obvious who leads. PRESSURISED might be the leader. He did so at Caulfield last time albeit slowly. Forget SP profile theories, that good effort last time was no fluke on his return at Pakenham. Flemington was a total forget run.  REDDIVO is fit and flying. He coped with coming back from 3600m to 2465m at Geelong when narrowly beaten. That's a good sign for him coming back from his big win last time over the 3172m. THREE REEL ROSES put up a good chase to win a race like this at Moe. She stays down in the weights. BATOKA CHIEF is in good form and the map looks right for him. AMAWASHA is ready to win again after a solid 3rd at Moe in this type of race.   OMAMORI is never far away in these races. GENRICHERO improved last time.

raceTips.comment: Quite an open race but Batoka Chief finished ahead of a few rivals last time and has claims to win. Omamori brings that same form and can figure in the finish. He's well placed in a BM62 with Jabez Johnstone's handy 1.5kg claim.  NICEREINE has had 27 days to get over his good return at Sale in a race like this. He'll get his chance from a good draw. bestBets.overview: Like the way ALIEN ANGEL travelled through the heavy ground here 1st up to win impressively. A northern hemisphere bred mare (she turns 4yo Jan 2027) she was always going to improve significantly on her debut earlier in the year. Doubt she'll have much trouble graduating to this class and better. ATAEGINA is better placed back to this class with a senior rider. She was good at Bendigo.  Like the way QUEEN AMANJENA held on last start at Sandown when not in the best part of the track. That wasn't GAME PLAN's best last time. Her two starts prior indicated a win was not far away. VIENNA VIXEN and TAN TAT DELIGHT next best.

raceTips.comment: Alien Angel was excellent when winning at this course first up, has more to offer and should appreciate the extra journey. Vienna Vixen is back down in grade which will help. Tan Tat Delight seemed to have its chance last time but has shown potential, while Queen Amanjena had excuses last time.

bestBets.overview: QUEENSBURY deserves a win after recording 4 placings from his past 4 in races like this one. With a genuine speed likely up front he should be suited getting a soft trail around midfield. RUSSIAN DUCHESS should be improved by her two runs back. She's well weighted and well drawn. Her only other 1600m start resulted in a 2nd to the highly rated Zakouma. FINANCE SHOGUN was terrific trying to lead all the way here last time. If he didn't get the pressure from Prestige Snitzel, he probably wins. Blinkers come off that horse, so maybe that pressure won't be there this time. ANNABELLE SUNSHINE is always big odds for a mare who puts her head down and has a crack. Any luck from the draw or a swooper bias and she's in the game. REINA ISABELLA  next from COUNT OF TOULOUSE.

raceTips.comment: Finance Shotgun was very brave when placing last time over the 1400m here after doing plenty of early work. Queensbury will find this easier and is consistent. Oshima has upside but has to bring the winning form from the Synthetic to the turf. Russian Duchess is fitter than most and maps well.

bestBets.overview: A wide open race to end the day. TURNAQUID is a big price ($31 to $26) in early markets for an honest mare. You have to go to her  end of prep runs to find a bad run. She worked home well at Bairnsdale 2nd up in a handy BM56. Her light weight of 55kg appeals in this field. I SAID SO was in the same race last time and he was good too. CASTELLITO resumes and like most stable runners has been kept very safe in the market. She is 40 weeks between runs but she is trialling well. Her latest was with a subsequent winner on Monday. Have seen her jump out well on a H10 13 months ago. ALPINE FOX was going to run on well 1st up when he ran out of room. ILLUMINANCE draws out but she is ready. That effort was very good last time. FLY BY LIGHT and UNAPPROACHABLE have claims too and could still overlook the winner.

raceTips.comment: Casellito has shown good promise in a handful of starts and looked solid in a recent jumpout. Faraway Dream will find this easier with the step to 1,200m being the main query. Illuminance was very brave last time and is in good order, while Paris Winds is good enough and should be fitter second up.
